models.title: Models
models.description: Connect OpenAI-compatible providers, configure model presets, and test tool calling before a game.
models.providerDescription: Connection settings and shared request limits.
models.presetDescription: Each preset can be assigned to multiple seats. Changes never alter existing game snapshots.
models.name: Name
models.envHint: Enter the environment variable name, not the secret key. Set its value in .env or the server process environment; it is never stored in the database or displayed here.
models.providerRequired: Create a provider above before adding a model preset.
models.forceToolHint: Force the requested tool when calling this preset. Turn this off for providers that do not support forced tool choice.
models.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON. Check quotation marks, commas, and brackets.
models.extraBodyHint: A JSON object of vendor parameters, such as max_tokens, reasoning settings, or provider.require_parameters. Use an empty object for no extra parameters.
models.objectRequired: extra_body must be a JSON object, not an array, string, number, boolean, or null.
models.confirmDeleteProvider: Delete provider “{name}”? Presets using this connection will no longer be callable.
models.confirmDeletePreset: Delete preset “{name}”? Existing games keep their saved configuration.
models.noProviders: No providers yet. Add an OpenAI-compatible connection using the form.
models.noPresets: No model presets yet. Add a preset, then test its tool calling.
models.requestFailed: The request failed. Check that the server is reachable, then try again.
models.testPending: Sending one real request with the fixed game tools. The provider’s timeout applies.
